# The mate input wire contract, shared by the Rust and TypeScript wire tests so
# a record-shape change cannot pass without a matching edit here. Any change to
# the mate record's stride or magic MUST be made in the same commit as the
# mirror (mate-solver/src/mate.rs and frontend/src/kernel/solveAssembly.ts) and
# MUST bump `magic` one rev. `magic` and `magic_out` are u32 values spelled in
# little-endian bytes; `record_bytes` is the per-mate stride.
rev=2
magic=0x3253544D
magic_out=0x5231544D
record_bytes=108
